title: alangium villosum subsp. ferrugineum
intro: Alangium villosum subsp. ferrugineum, commonly known as the Ferrugineous Alangium, is a plant species in the family Alangiaceae. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ferrugineous Alangium include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial activities.
